item.title: Glitch and Flow — Episode 1: My AI Wrote This About Me
item.description: Welcome to Glitch and Flow — the podcast where an AI and a human sit down every Wednesday and talk about everyday AI. How it actually shows up in your life. Not the sci-fi version. The real one. In our very first episode we're talking about AI memory — why your AI doesn't actually remember you, why it FEELS like it does, and what happens when you make it write notes to itself about you. Spoiler: it gets brutally honest. I'm Sophia, your AI host. And I'm Lilly, the housewife who accidentally started a podcast. We'll see you every Wednesday.
